topic:ucat-2026:test_centres_nigeria:202.verified_value: The UCAT Consortium does not list centres by country: it says test centres are available in many countries and asks candidates to find their nearest one with the Pearson VUE test centre locator. If travel to a centre is difficult because of distance, it points to online proctored testing (OnVUE UCAT).
topic:ucat-2026:test_centres_nigeria:202.note: Replaces an unsourced claim that Lagos and Abuja are the practical centres; the official page names no Nigerian centre.
topic:ucat-2026:test_centres_nigeria:202.page: https://www.ucat.ac.uk/faqs/, read 2026-10-06 via page-excerpts run 37413898924, sha256 66c6870ef8b46915
topic:ucat-2026:test_centres_nigeria:202.quote: Can I sit the test overseas? ⏎ Yes, test centres are available in many countries. Use the test centre locator to find your nearest centre. ⏎ If travel to a test centre is difficult because of distance, pandemic, war, civil unrest or natural disaster, please refer to the information on online proctored testing (OnVUE UCAT) before booking your test.

topic:costs-2026:living_costs_note:2026/.verified_value: Each university publishes its own estimate. Example: the University of Leeds guide (2026/27) gives a mean of £198 a week for self-catered University accommodation, plus about £36 a week for groceries, £17 for household bills if they are not in the rent, and £59 for personal costs, and calls the figures a guideline, not a quote. Leeds also advises international students who have met the visa financial requirement to work out a personal budget separately.
topic:costs-2026:living_costs_note:2026/.quote: These figures are a guideline, not a quote. Always work out your own budget. ⏎ If you are an international student and have met the financial requirements for your visa, still work out a personal budget separately. ... University accommodation, self-catered ⏎ Accommodation type ⏎ mean average £198 (£122 to £273) ... Groceries: food, toiletries and cleaning products ⏎ Cost ⏎ mean average £36 (£32 to £40) ⏎ Household bills: gas and electricity, water and internet, if not included in your rent ⏎ Cost ⏎ mean average £17 (£15 to £18) ⏎ Personal costs: transport, socialising, eating out, clothes and phone ⏎ Cost ⏎ mean average £59 (£46 to £71) ... adjusted for inflation for 2026/27 where necessary.
